title: Adi-khanda, part 15 (portion 23)
html:
The journey to Gaya: the Lord teaches and resolves to perform the rite for His father; farewell to Shachi; on the way all hasten to see Him; the lesson of the deer; on Mount Mandara — a fever cured by the water of a brahmana's feet, and the teaching about brahmanas; the meeting with Ishvara Puri and initiation; the moods of Vraja; the rites in Gaya, prema at the Vishnupada; the wish to go to Vrindavana and the heavenly voice; the return to Nadia; the conclusion of the Adi-khanda

Kaishora-lila (Youth): the Lord's journey to Gaya

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. After some time Gaurasundara, having concluded the lila of studying, took up teaching. Then, on the pretext of offering pinda for His father, He graciously set out for Gaya. On the way He gave His darshan to all the beasts and birds and drew them to His feet; and to teach reverence for brahmanas He enacted the lila of being cured of His illness by drinking the water that had washed a brahmana's feet, and He also taught that one who does not worship Krishna can never be a brahmana. Then, coming to Gaya and worshipping the gods and the ancestors, He went to see the Vishnupada. There He met Ishvara Puri, the best of devotees, and, to show him mercy, He asked him for a mantra. As soon as the Lord received the Krishna mantra from Ishvara Puri, bhava arose in Him, and He became eager to see the Vishnupada. Seeing the Vishnupada, Sriman Mahaprabhu, overwhelmed with prema, displayed laughter, dancing, singing and other signs of prema, and, staying there only a few days, returned home1.

Raga varadi; disha: "My life — Dvijachand!"

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু আনন্দ-কৌতুকে ।
সুখে নিবসয়ে বন্ধু-বান্ধব-সহিতে ॥ ১ ॥

tabe sei mahāprabhu ānanda-kautuke |
sukhe nibasaẏe bandhu-bāndhaba-sahite || 1 ||

tabe sei mahaprabhu — thus Mahaprabhu; ananda-kautuke — in joy and delight; sukhe nivasaye — lived happily; bandhu-bandhava-sahite — with relatives and friends

1Thus Mahaprabhu, in joy and delight,
lived happily together with His relatives and friends.

নবদ্বীপপুরবাসী যতেক ব্রাহ্মণ ।
ধন্য ধন্য করি সভে সভারে কথন ॥ ২ ॥

nabadbīpapurabāsī yateka brāhmaṇa |
dhanya dhanya kari sabhe sabhāre kathana || 2 ||

navadvipa-pura-vasi — dwelling in Navadvipa; yateka brahmana — all the brahmanas; dhanya dhanya kari — saying "Blessed, blessed!"; sabhe sabhare kathana — all say to one another

2All the brahmanas living in Navadvipa
say to one another: "Blessed, blessed!"

লৌকিক-সৎক্রিয়াবিধি পড়ে শিষ্যগণ ।
আপনি পড়ায় প্রভু পুরুষ-রতন ॥ ৩ ॥

laukika-satkriẏābidhi paṛe śiṣyagaṇa |
āpani paṛāẏa prabhu puruṣa-ratana || 3 ||

laukika-sat-kriya-vidhi — the rules of auspicious worldly rites; pade shishya-gana — the students study; apani padaya prabhu — the Lord Himself teaches; purusha-ratana — the jewel among men

3The students study the rules of the auspicious worldly rites —
they are taught by the Lord Himself, the jewel among men.

বৃহস্পতি জিনি কবি কাব্যরস জানে ।
আপনি ঈশ্বর স্তুতি কি বলি বচনে ॥ ৪ ॥

bṛhaspati jini kabi kābyarasa jāne |
āpani īśbara stuti ki bali bacane || 4 ||

brihaspati jini — surpassing Brihaspati; kavi — poet; kavya-rasa jane — knows the taste of poetry; apani ishvara — Ishvara Himself; stuti ki bali vachane — with what words to praise

4He surpasses Brihaspati, He is a poet who knows the taste of poetry;
He is Ishvara Himself: with what words can He be praised?

শিষ্যের মহিমা কেবা কহিবারে পারু ।
আপনে পড়ায় যারে জগতের গুরু ॥ ৫ ॥

śiṣyera mahimā kebā kahibāre pāru |
āpane paṛāẏa yāre jagatera guru || 5 ||

shishyera mahima — the greatness of the students; keba kahibare paru — who can describe; apane padaya yare — whom Himself teaches; jagatera guru — the Teacher of the world

5Who can describe the greatness of the students
whom the Teacher of the world Himself teaches?

কোটি-সরস্বতী-কান্ত প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভরে ।
বিদ্যারসে কৃপা করে পণ্ডিত সকলে ॥ ৬ ॥

koṭi-sarasbatī-kānta prabhu biśbambhare |
bidyārase kṛpā kare paṇḍita sakale || 6 ||

koti-sarasvati-kanta — beloved of millions of Sarasvatis; prabhu vishvambhare — the Lord Vishvambhara; vidya-rase — with the taste of learning; kripa kare — shows mercy; pandita sakale — to all the pandits

6The Lord Vishvambhara, beloved of millions of Sarasvatis,
grants all the pandits His mercy — the taste of learning.

এইমতে লোকশিক্ষা করে বিশ্বম্ভর ।
গয়া করিবারে যাব করিলা অন্তর ॥ ৭ ॥

eimate lokaśikṣā kare biśbambhara |
gaẏā karibāre yāba karilā antara || 7 ||

eimate — thus; loka-shiksha kare — instructs the people; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; gaya karibare yaba — I shall go to perform [the rite in] Gaya; karila antara — resolved in His heart

7Thus Vishvambhara instructed the people;
He resolved: "I shall go to perform the rite in Gaya2.

পিতৃ-পিণ্ডদান দিব গয়াশিরোপরি ।
গদাধর আর বিষ্ণুপদে নমস্করি ॥ ৮ ॥

pitṛ-piṇḍadāna diba gaẏāśiropari |
gadādhara āra biṣṇupade namaskari || 8 ||

pitri-pinda-dana diba — I shall offer pinda for My father; gaya-shiropari — on the head of Gaya; gadadhara ara vishnupade — to Gadadhara and the Vishnupada; namaskari — bowing

8I shall offer pinda for My father on the head of Gaya
and bow to Gadadhara and to the Vishnupada."

এত বলি শুভযাত্রা করিল ঠাকুর ।
সংহতি চলিল বিপ্রগণ মহাকুল ॥ ৯ ॥

eta bali śubhayātrā karila ṭhākura |
saṃhati calila bipragaṇa mahākula || 9 ||

eta bali — saying this; shubha-yatra karila thakura — the Thakura set out on the auspicious journey; samhati chalila — went with Him; vipra-gana maha-kula — brahmanas of noble families

9Saying this, the Thakura set out on the auspicious journey;
with Him went brahmanas of noble families.

শচীর অন্তর পোড়ে গদগদ ভাষ ।
পুত্রের নিকটে গিয়া ছাড়য়ে নিঃশ্বাস ॥ ১০ ॥

śacīra antara poṛe gadagada bhāṣa |
putrera nikaṭe giẏā chāṛaẏe niḥśbāsa || 10 ||

shachira antara pode — Shachi's heart burns; gadagada bhasha — her voice falters; putrera nikate giya — coming to her son; chhadaye nihshvasa — she sighs heavily

10Shachi's heart burns, her voice falters;
coming to her son, she sighs heavily:

প্রবাসে যাইবে তুমি শুন বিশ্বম্ভর ।
তোমা না দেখিলে অন্ধকার মোর ঘর ॥ ১১ ॥

prabāse yāibe tumi śuna biśbambhara |
tomā nā dekhile andhakāra mora ghara || 11 ||

pravase yaibe tumi — You will go to foreign lands; shuna vishvambhara — listen, Vishvambhara; toma na dekhile — not seeing You; andhakara mora ghara — my house is darkness

11"You are going to foreign lands — listen, Vishvambhara:
without You there is darkness in my house.

আন্ধলের নড়ি মোর নয়ানের তারা ।
এ দেহের আত্মা তোমা বহি নাহি মোরা ॥ ১২ ॥

āndhalera naṛi mora naẏānera tārā |
e dehera ātmā tomā bahi nāhi morā || 12 ||

andhalera nadi — the blind woman's staff; mora nayanera tara — the pupil of my eyes; e dehera atma — the soul of this body; toma bahi nahi mora — I have none but You

12You are the blind woman's staff, the pupil of my eyes,
the soul of this body — I have no one but You.

পিতৃগণ-নিস্তার করিতে যাবে তুমি ।
আপনা লাগিয়া তোরে কি বলিব আমি ॥ ১৩ ॥

pitṛgaṇa-nistāra karite yābe tumi |
āpanā lāgiẏā tore ki baliba āmi || 13 ||

pitri-gana-nistara karite — to deliver the ancestors; yabe tumi — You are going; apana lagiya — for my own sake; tore ki baliba ami — what shall I say to You

13You are going to deliver the ancestors —
what shall I say to You for my own sake?

গয়া যদি যাবি বাপ শুন রে নিমাঞি ।
মোর নামে এক পিণ্ড দিস রে তথাই ॥ ১৩+১ ॥

gaẏā yadi yābi bāpa śuna re nimāñi |
mora nāme eka piṇḍa disa re tathāi || 13+1 ||

gaya yadi yabi bapa — if you go to Gaya, son; shuna re nimani — listen, Nimai; mora name — in my name; eka pinda — one pinda; disa re tathai — offer there

13+1If You go to Gaya, son — listen, Nimai —
offer there one pinda in my name too"3.

এতেক বচন যবে বৈল শচীমাতা ।
মধুর বচনে তার প্রবোধিল কথা ॥ ১৪ ॥

eteka bacana yabe baila śacīmātā |
madhura bacane tāra prabodhila kathā || 14 ||

eteka vachana yabe baila — when she spoke such words; shachi-mata — mother Shachi; madhura vachane — with sweet speech; tara prabodhila katha — He consoled her words

14When mother Shachi spoke such words,
He consoled her with sweet speech:

তোমার নিকটে যেন আছি নিরন্তর ।
এমন জানিবে মাতা কহিল উত্তর ॥ ১৫ ॥

tomāra nikaṭe yena āchi nirantara |
emana jānibe mātā kahila uttara || 15 ||

tomara nikate — near you; yena achhi nirantara — that I am always; emana janibe mata — know this, mother; kahila uttara — He replied

15"Know, mother, that I am always
near you" — so He replied.

পুত্র পিণ্ড লাগি প্রয়োজন সর্বলোকে ।
মোরে কৃপা-আজ্ঞা কর না করিহ শোকে ॥ ১৬ ॥

putra piṇḍa lāgi praẏojana sarbaloke |
more kṛpā-ājñā kara nā kariha śoke || 16 ||

putra — a son; pinda lagi — for the pinda; prayojana sarvaloke — all people need; more kripa-ajna kara — kindly give Me leave; na kariha shoke — do not grieve

16"All people need a son for the sake of the pinda;
kindly give Me leave — do not grieve".

চলিলা ত বিশ্বম্ভর গয়া করিবারে ।
সংহতি চলিল বিপ্র হরিষ অন্তরে ॥ ১৭ ॥

calilā ta biśbambhara gaẏā karibāre |
saṃhati calila bipra hariṣa antare || 17 ||

chalila ta vishvambhara — thus Vishvambhara set out; gaya karibare — to perform [the rite in] Gaya; samhati chalila vipra — brahmanas went with Him; harisha antare — with joy in their hearts

17Thus Vishvambhara set out to perform the rite in Gaya;
with Him went brahmanas with joy in their hearts.

যে পথে চলয়ে প্রভু শচীর নন্দন ।
সে পথের লোক দেখি জুড়ায় নয়ন ॥ ১৮ ॥

ye pathe calaẏe prabhu śacīra nandana |
se pathera loka dekhi juṛāẏa naẏana || 18 ||

ye pathe chalaye — on whatever road goes; prabhu shachira nandana — the Lord, the son of Shachi; se pathera loka — the people of that road; dekhi — seeing; judaya nayana — delight their eyes

18Whatever road the Lord, the son of Shachi, travelled,
the people on that road, seeing Him, delight their eyes.

বাল বৃদ্ধ পঙ্গু জড় ধায় দেখিবারে ।
পশু পক্ষী ধায় সব অশ্রু নেত্রে ঝরে ॥ ১৯ ॥

bāla bṛddha paṅgu jaṛa dhāẏa dekhibāre |
paśu pakṣī dhāẏa saba aśru netre jhare || 19 ||

bala vriddha pangu jada — children, the old, the lame, the infirm; dhaya dekhibare — run to see; pashu pakshi dhaya saba — all beasts and birds run; ashru netre jhare — tears stream from their eyes

19Children, the old, the lame, the infirm run to see;
all the beasts and birds run — tears stream from their eyes.

কুলবধূ ধায় সব কুলত্যাগ করি ।
সভে বোলে এই দেখ ব্রজের শ্রীহরি ॥ ২০ ॥

kulabadhū dhāẏa saba kulatyāga kari |
sabhe bole ei dekha brajera śrīhari || 20 ||

kulavadhu dhaya saba — all the wives of noble families run; kula-tyaga kari — abandoning their families; sabhe bole — all say; ei dekha — look, here is; vrajera shrihari — Sri Hari of Vraja

20All the wives of noble families run, forgetting their families;
all say: "Look — here is Sri Hari of Vraja!"

ইহা বলি ধায় লোক না বান্ধয়ে কেশ ।
উন্মত্ত করিল প্রভু ভ্রমি সর্বদেশ ॥ ২১ ॥

ihā bali dhāẏa loka nā bāndhaẏe keśa |
unmatta karila prabhu bhrami sarbadeśa || 21 ||

iha bali — saying this; dhaya loka — people run; na bandhaye kesha — without tying their hair; unmatta karila prabhu — the Lord maddened [them]; bhrami sarvadesha — passing through all lands

21Saying this, people run without tying their hair —
the Lord, passing through all lands, drove everyone mad.

সর্বপথে এইমতে সর্বলোক ধায় ।
সর্বলোকে প্রেমরস-সাগরে ভাসায় ॥ ২২ ॥

sarbapathe eimate sarbaloka dhāẏa |
sarbaloke premarasa-sāgare bhāsāẏa || 22 ||

sarva-pathe — on all roads; eimate — thus; sarvaloka dhaya — all people run; sarvaloke — all people; prema-rasa-sagare — in the ocean of the rasa of prema; bhasaya — He sets afloat

22Thus on every road all the people run —
He plunges all into the ocean of the rasa of prema.

পথে যাইতে একঠাঞি দেখে গৌরহরি ।
কুরঙ্গ-কুরঙ্গী কেলি করে একমেলি ॥ ২৩ ॥

pathe yāite ekaṭhāñi dekhe gaurahari |
kuraṅga-kuraṅgī keli kare ekameli || 23 ||

pathe yaite — going along the road; eka-thani — in one place; dekhe gaurahari — Gaurahari sees; kuranga-kurangi — a buck and a doe; keli kare eka-meli — frolic together

23Going along the road, Gaurahari sees in one place
a buck and a doe frolicking together.

মৃগের কৌতুক দেখি ভেল কুতূহল ।
প্রাকৃতলোকের মত হাসে খল খল ॥ ২৪ ॥

mṛgera kautuka dekhi bhela kutūhala |
prākṛtalokera mata hāse khala khala || 24 ||

mrigera kautuka — the play of the deer; dekhi — seeing; bhela kutuhala — He was amused; prakrita-lokera mata — like an ordinary man; hase khala khala — laughs heartily

24Seeing the play of the deer, He was amused
and, like an ordinary man, laughed heartily.

লোভ-মোহ-কাম-ক্রোধে মত্ত পশুগণ ।
কৃষ্ণ না ভজিলে এইমত সর্বজন ॥ ২৫ ॥

lobha-moha-kāma-krodhe matta paśugaṇa |
kṛṣṇa nā bhajile eimata sarbajana || 25 ||

lobha-moha-kama-krodhe — with greed, delusion, lust and anger; matta pashu-gana — the beasts are intoxicated; krishna na bhajile — if they do not worship Krishna; eimata sarvajana — so are all people

25Beasts are intoxicated with greed, delusion, lust and anger;
so are all people if they do not worship Krishna.

সঙ্গিগণে হাসিয়া বুঝান ভগবান্ ।
যে বুদ্ধি পশুতে সে মানুষে বিদ্যমান ॥ ২৬ ॥

saṅgigaṇe hāsiẏā bujhāna bhagabān |
ye buddhi paśute se mānuṣe bidyamāna || 26 ||

sangi-gane — to the companions; hasiya — smiling; bujhana bhagavan — Bhagavan explains; ye buddhi pashute — the intelligence that is in beasts; se manushe vidyamana — is present in men

26Smiling, Bhagavan explains to His companions:
"The same intelligence that beasts have is present in men;

কৃষ্ণজ্ঞান নাঞি মাত্র পশুর শরীরে ।
মনুষ্যে না ভজে কৃষ্ণ পশু বলি তারে ॥ ২৭ ॥

kṛṣṇajñāna nāñi mātra paśura śarīre |
manuṣye nā bhaje kṛṣṇa paśu bali tāre || 27 ||

krishna-jnana nani — there is no knowledge of Krishna; matra pashura sharire — only in the body of a beast; manushye na bhaje krishna — a man who does not worship Krishna; pashu bali tare — is called a beast

27only in the body of a beast there is no knowledge of Krishna —
and a man who does not worship Krishna is called a beast."

এত বুঝাইয়া প্রভু জগতের গুরু ।
চলিলা পথেতে প্রভু বাঞ্ছাকল্পতরু ॥ ২৮ ॥

eta bujhāiẏā prabhu jagatera guru |
calilā pathete prabhu bāñchākalpataru || 28 ||

eta bujhaiya — having explained thus; prabhu jagatera guru — the Lord, the Teacher of the world; chalila pathete — went on His way; prabhu vanchha-kalpataru — the Lord, the Wish-fulfilling Tree

28Having explained all this, the Lord, the Teacher of the world,
the Lord who is the Wish-fulfilling Tree, went on His way.

তবে সেই চিরনামে আছে এক নদী ।
স্নানদান কৈল প্রভু যে আছিল বিধি ॥ ২৯ ॥

tabe sei ciranāme āche eka nadī |
snānadāna kaila prabhu ye āchila bidhi || 29 ||

tabe — then; sei chira-name — named Chira; achhe eka nadi — there is a river; snana-dana kaila prabhu — the Lord bathed and gave gifts; ye achhila vidhi — as was prescribed

29Then — a river named Chira;
there the Lord bathed and gave gifts as prescribed4.

দেবপূজা পিতৃপূজা করি হরষিতে ।
মন্দারে উঠিলা প্রভু দেবতা দেখিতে ॥ ৩০ ॥

debapūjā pitṛpūjā kari haraṣite |
mandāre uṭhilā prabhu debatā dekhite || 30 ||

deva-puja pitri-puja — worship of gods and ancestors; kari harashite — joyfully performing; mandare uthila prabhu — the Lord climbed Mandara; devata dekhite — to see the Deity

30Joyfully performing the worship of the gods and the ancestors,
the Lord climbed Mandara to see the Deity.

দেবতা দেখিয়া প্রভু নামিলা সত্বর ।
পর্বত-নিকটে বাসা ব্রাহ্মণের ঘর ॥ ৩১ ॥

debatā dekhiẏā prabhu nāmilā satbara |
parbata-nikaṭe bāsā brāhmaṇera ghara || 31 ||

devata dekhiya — having seen the Deity; prabhu namila satvara — the Lord quickly descended; parvata-nikate — near the mountain; basa — lodging; brahmanera ghara — in a brahmana's house

31Having seen the Deity, the Lord quickly came down;
at the foot of the mountain He stayed in a brahmana's house.

হেনকালে বিশ্বম্ভর-সঙ্গের ব্রাহ্মণ ।
সে-দেশের বিপ্র দেখি দোষে তার মন ॥ ৩২ ॥

henakāle biśbambhara-saṅgera brāhmaṇa |
se-deśera bipra dekhi doṣe tāra mana || 32 ||

henakale — then; vishvambhara-sangera brahmana — the brahmanas accompanying Vishvambhara; se-deshera vipra dekhi — seeing the brahmanas of that land; doshe tara mana — their minds find fault

32Then the brahmanas accompanying Vishvambhara,
seeing the brahmanas of that land, found fault with them in their minds.

দেশ-আচরণ তারা করে যথাবিধি ।
দেখিয়া ব্রাহ্মণে তার নাহি বিপ্রবুদ্ধি ॥ ৩৩ ॥

deśa-ācaraṇa tārā kare yathābidhi |
dekhiẏā brāhmaṇe tāra nāhi biprabuddhi || 33 ||

desha-acharana — the customs of their land; tara kare yathavidhi — they follow as is their rule; dekhiya — seeing [this]; brahmane — in those brahmanas; tara nahi vipra-buddhi — they did not see brahmanas

33These followed the customs of their land as was their way;
seeing this, [the Lord's companions] did not regard them as brahmanas5.

ব্রাহ্মণে অবজ্ঞা দেখি প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
প্রকাশিব দ্বিজভক্তি করিলা অন্তর ॥ ৩৪ ॥

brāhmaṇe abajñā dekhi prabhu biśbambhara |
prakāśiba dbijabhakti karilā antara || 34 ||

brahmane avajna dekhi — seeing disregard for brahmanas; prabhu vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara; prakashiba dvija-bhakti — I shall show reverence for brahmanas; karila antara — resolved in His heart

34Seeing this disregard for brahmanas, the Lord Vishvambhara
resolved to show reverence for brahmanas.

আচম্বিতে প্রভুদেহে আইল মহাজ্বর ।
জ্বর দেখি ত্রাস পাইল সভার অন্তর ॥ ৩৫ ॥

ācambite prabhudehe āila mahājbara |
jbara dekhi trāsa pāila sabhāra antara || 35 ||

achambite — suddenly; prabhu-dehe aila maha-jvara — a high fever came upon the Lord's body; jvara dekhi — seeing the fever; trasa paila sabhara antara — all were frightened at heart

35Suddenly a high fever seized the Lord's body;
seeing the fever, all were frightened at heart6.

বলিলা ঠাকুর শুন শুন সর্বজন ।
দেব-পিতৃকার্যে বিঘ্ন ভেল কি-কারণ ॥ ৩৬ ॥

balilā ṭhākura śuna śuna sarbajana |
deba-pitṛkārye bighna bhela ki-kāraṇa || 36 ||

balila thakura — the Thakura said; shuna shuna sarvajana — listen, listen, all of you; deva-pitri-karye — to the rite for gods and ancestors; vighna bhela — an obstacle arose; ki-karana — for what reason

36The Thakura said: "Listen, listen, all of you:
for what reason has an obstacle arisen to the rite for the gods and the ancestors?

না জানি কি মোর দোষে সঙ্গিগণ-দোষে ।
শ্রেয়ঃকার্যে বিঘ্ন হয় বড় অসন্তোষে ॥ ৩৭ ॥

nā jāni ki mora doṣe saṅgigaṇa-doṣe |
śreẏaḥkārye bighna haẏa baṛa asantoṣe || 37 ||

na jani — I do not know; ki mora doshe — whether through My fault; sangi-gana-doshe — or through the fault of My companions; shreyah-karye vighna haya — an obstacle arises to the auspicious work; bada asantoshe — to great displeasure

37I do not know — through My fault or through the fault of My companions —
an obstacle has arisen to the auspicious work, and this grieves Me greatly.

সর্ববিঘ্ন-নিবারণ আছয়ে উপায় ।
বিপ্রপাদোদক মোরে দেহ ত জুড়ায় ॥ ৩৮ ॥

sarbabighna-nibāraṇa āchaẏe upāẏa |
biprapādodaka more deha ta juṛāẏa || 38 ||

sarva-vighna-nivarana — removing all obstacles; achhaye upaya — there is a remedy; vipra-padodaka — the water of a brahmana's feet; more deha ta — give Me; judaya — it brings relief

38There is a remedy that removes all obstacles:
give Me the water that has washed a brahmana's feet — it will bring relief.

বিপ্রপাদোদক খাইলে সর্বপাপ হরে ।
এখনে ঘুচিব জ্বর কি করিতে পারে ॥ ৩৯ ॥

biprapādodaka khāile sarbapāpa hare |
ekhane ghuciba jbara ki karite pāre || 39 ||

vipra-padodaka khaile — when the water of a brahmana's feet is drunk; sarva-papa hare — it destroys all sins; ekhane ghuchiba jvara — the fever will go at once; ki karite pare — what can it do

39The water of a brahmana's feet, when drunk, destroys all sins —
the fever will go at once: what can it do?"

সেইখানে সেইদেশী আছিল ব্রাহ্মণ ।
আপনে উঠিয়া তার পাখালে চরণ ॥ ৪০ ॥

seikhāne seideśī āchila brāhmaṇa |
āpane uṭhiẏā tāra pākhāle caraṇa || 40 ||

seikhane — there; sei-deshi achhila brahmana — there was a local brahmana; apane uthiya — rising Himself; tara pakhale charana — washed his feet

40A local brahmana was there;
[the Lord] rose Himself and washed his feet.

বিপ্রপাদোদক-পান কৈল বিশ্বম্ভর ।
প্রকাশিল দ্বিজভক্তি পলাইল জ্বর ॥ ৪১ ॥

biprapādodaka-pāna kaila biśbambhara |
prakāśila dbijabhakti palāila jbara || 41 ||

vipra-padodaka-pana kaila — drank the water of the brahmana's feet; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; prakashila dvija-bhakti — showed reverence for brahmanas; palaila jvara — the fever fled

41Vishvambhara drank the water of the brahmana's feet,
showed reverence for brahmanas — and the fever fled.

সঙ্কোচে সে দ্বিজবর বোলে চাটুবাণী ।
আমার অন্তর-দোষে দুঃখ পাইলে তুমি ॥ ৪২ ॥

saṅkoce se dbijabara bole cāṭubāṇī |
āmāra antara-doṣe duḥkha pāile tumi || 42 ||

sankoche — abashed; se dvijavara — that best of brahmanas; bole chatu-vani — speaks humble words; amara antara-doshe — because of the fault in my heart; duhkha paile tumi — You suffered pain

42Then the abashed best of brahmanas speaks humble words:
"Because of the fault in my heart You have suffered pain.

কুৎসিত আচার দেখি মোর মন দোষে ।
মোর মন-দোষে তুমি পাইলে অসন্তোষে ॥ ৪৩ ॥

kutsita ācāra dekhi mora mana doṣe |
mora mana-doṣe tumi pāile asantoṣe || 43 ||

kutsita achara dekhi — seeing [their] customs as bad; mora mana doshe — my mind found fault; mora mana-doshe — because of my mind's fault; tumi paile asantoshe — You were displeased

43Seeing [their] customs as bad, my mind found fault [with them];
because of the fault in my mind You were displeased.

এখনে ব্রাহ্মণভক্তি প্রকাশিলে তুমি ।
অপরাধ কৈলু দেব ক্ষমিবে আপনি ॥ ৪৪ ॥

ekhane brāhmaṇabhakti prakāśile tumi |
aparādha kailu deba kṣamibe āpani || 44 ||

ekhane — now; brahmana-bhakti prakashile tumi — You have shown reverence for brahmanas; aparadha kailu — I committed an offence; deva — Lord; kshamibe apani — please forgive

44Now You have shown reverence for brahmanas;
I have committed an offence — You, Lord, forgive me.

তুমি সে ব্রহ্মণ্য দ্বিজভক্তি-অধিকারী ।
ভৃগুমুনি-পদচিহ্ন নিজবক্ষে ধরি ॥ ৪৫ ॥

tumi se brahmaṇya dbijabhakti-adhikārī |
bhṛgumuni-padacihna nijabakṣe dhari || 45 ||

tumi se brahmanya — You are Brahmanya; dvija-bhakti-adhikari — the guardian of reverence for brahmanas; bhrigu-muni-pada-chihna — the mark of the sage Bhrigu's foot; nija-vakshe dhari — bearing on Your chest

45You are Brahmanya, You are the guardian of reverence for brahmanas,
bearing on Your chest the mark of the sage Bhrigu's foot7.

নিজভক্তি-মহিমা প্রকাশ নিজমুখে ।
জগতের নিস্তার করহ এইরূপে ॥ ৪৬ ॥

nijabhakti-mahimā prakāśa nijamukhe |
jagatera nistāra karaha eirūpe || 46 ||

nija-bhakti-mahima — the glory of devotion to You; prakasha nija-mukhe — You reveal with Your own lips; jagatera nistara karaha — You deliver the world; ei-rupe — in this way

46With Your own lips You reveal the glory of devotion to You
and thus deliver the world.

জয় বিশ্বম্ভরপ্রিয় জয় দ্বিজরাজ ।
তোমায় সেবিলে সিদ্ধ হয় সব কাজ ॥ ৪৭ ॥

jaẏa biśbambharapriẏa jaẏa dbijarāja |
tomāẏa sebile siddha haẏa saba kāja || 47 ||

jaya vishvambhara-priya — glory, beloved Vishvambhara; jaya dvijaraja — glory, king of brahmanas; tomaya sevile — by serving You; siddha haya saba kaja — every undertaking succeeds

47Glory to You, beloved Vishvambhara! Glory to You, king of brahmanas!
For one who serves You every undertaking succeeds.

নম দ্বিজবল্লভ দয়ালু গৌরহরি ।
নম ধর্মসংস্থাপন সর্ব অধিকারী ॥ ৪৮ ॥

nama dbijaballabha daẏālu gaurahari |
nama dharmasaṃsthāpana sarba adhikārī || 48 ||

nama — obeisance; dvija-vallabha — lover of brahmanas; dayalu gaurahari — merciful Gaurahari; nama — obeisance; dharma-samsthapana — establisher of dharma; sarva adhikari — Lord of all

48Obeisance to You, merciful Gaurahari, lover of brahmanas!
Obeisance to You, establisher of dharma, Lord of all!"

সঙ্গীর এতেক বাক্য শুনি বিশ্বম্ভর ।
ক্ষমা কৈলা সভাকার দোষ বহুতর ॥ ৪৯ ॥

saṅgīra eteka bākya śuni biśbambhara |
kṣamā kailā sabhākāra doṣa bahutara || 49 ||

sangira eteka vakya — such words of the companion; shuni vishvambhara — hearing, Vishvambhara; kshama kaila — forgave; sabhakara dosha bahutara — the many faults of all

49Hearing such words from His companion, Vishvambhara
forgave all of them their many faults.

ইহারা পূজয়ে মধুসূদন ঠাকুর ।
এ সকল ত্যজ্য নহে না ভাবিহ দূর ॥ ৫০ ॥

ihārā pūjaẏe madhusūdana ṭhākura |
e sakala tyajya nahe nā bhābiha dūra || 50 ||

ihara pujaye — they worship; madhusudana thakura — Thakura Madhusudana; e sakala tyajya nahe — these are not to be rejected; na bhaviha dura — do not consider them outsiders

50"They worship Thakura Madhusudana;
they are not to be rejected — do not regard them as outsiders.

কৃষ্ণ না ভজিলে দ্বিজ নহে কদাচিত ।
পুরাণে প্রমাণ এই শিক্ষা আছে নীত ॥ ৫১ ॥

kṛṣṇa nā bhajile dbija nahe kadācita |
purāṇe pramāṇa ei śikṣā āche nīta || 51 ||

krishna na bhajile — one who does not worship Krishna; dvija nahe kadachita — is never twice-born; purane pramana — the proof is in the Puranas; ei shiksha achhe nita — this teaching is established

51One who does not worship Krishna is never twice-born —
this teaching is confirmed by the Puranas."

Thus [it is said]8:

চণ্ডালোঽপি মুনেঃ শ্রেষ্ঠো বিষ্ণুভক্তিপরায়ণঃ ।
বিষ্ণুভক্তিবিহীনস্তু দ্বিজোঽপি শ্বপচাধমঃ ॥ ৫২ ॥

caṇḍālo'pi muneḥ śreṣṭho biṣṇubhaktiparāẏaṇaḥ |
biṣṇubhaktibihīnastu dbijo'pi śbapacādhamaḥ || 52 ||

chandalah api — even a chandala; muneh shreshthah — better than a sage; vishnu-bhakti-parayanah — devoted to Vishnu; vishnu-bhakti-vihinah tu — but devoid of devotion to Vishnu; dvijah api — even a twice-born; shvapacha-adhamah — lower than a dog-eater

52"Even a chandala devoted to Vishnu is better than a sage;
but a twice-born devoid of devotion to Vishnu is lower than a dog-eater."

ইহা বলি সঙ্গের ব্রাহ্মণে তুষ্ট হইয়া ।
দোষ ক্ষমাইলা তারে প্রসন্ন হইয়া ॥ ৫৩ ॥

ihā bali saṅgera brāhmaṇe tuṣṭa haiẏā |
doṣa kṣamāilā tāre prasanna haiẏā || 53 ||

iha bali — saying this; sangera brahmane — with the brahmana companions; tushta haiya — pleased; dosha kshamaila tare — forgave them their fault; prasanna haiya — graciously

53Saying this, He was pleased with His brahmana companions
and graciously forgave them their fault.

এইমতে প্রভু দ্বিজভক্তি প্রকাশিয়া ।
পুনঃপুনা-নদীতীর্থে উত্তরিলা গিয়া ॥ ৫৪ ॥

eimate prabhu dbijabhakti prakāśiẏā |
punaḥpunā-nadītīrthe uttarilā giẏā || 54 ||

eimate — thus; prabhu dvija-bhakti prakashiya — the Lord, having shown reverence for brahmanas; punahpuna-nadi-tirthe — at the holy place on the river Punahpuna; uttarila giya — arrived

54Having thus shown reverence for brahmanas,
[the Lord] came to the holy place on the river Punahpuna.

স্নান-দেবার্চন তথি করিলা তখন ।
পিতৃকার্য সমাধিয়া করিলা গমন ॥ ৫৫ ॥

snāna-debārcana tathi karilā takhana |
pitṛkārya samādhiẏā karilā gamana || 55 ||

snana-devarchana — bath and worship of the Deity; tathi karila takhana — He performed there then; pitri-karya samadhiya — completing the rites for the ancestors; karila gamana — went on

55Performing there His bath and the worship of the Deity,
and completing the rites for the ancestors, He went on.

তবে ত উত্তম তীর্থ রাজগিরি নাম ।
ব্রহ্মকুণ্ডে গিয়া প্রভু কৈল স্নানদান ॥ ৫৬ ॥

tabe ta uttama tīrtha rājagiri nāma |
brahmakuṇḍe giẏā prabhu kaila snānadāna || 56 ||

tabe ta — then; uttama tirtha — an excellent holy place; rajagiri nama — named Rajagiri; brahma-kunde giya — coming to the Brahma-kunda; prabhu kaila snana-dana — the Lord bathed and gave gifts

56Then — the excellent holy place called Rajagiri:
coming to the Brahma-kunda, the Lord bathed and gave gifts9.

দেবপূজা পিতৃপূজা কৈলা সেই ঠায় ।
বিষ্ণুপদ দেখিবারে চলিলা ত্বরায় ॥ ৫৭ ॥

debapūjā pitṛpūjā kailā sei ṭhāẏa |
biṣṇupada dekhibāre calilā tbarāẏa || 57 ||

deva-puja pitri-puja — worship of gods and ancestors; kaila sei thaya — He performed there; vishnupada dekhibare — to see the Vishnupada; chalila tvaraya — He hastened

57Having performed there the worship of the gods and the ancestors,
He hastened to see the Vishnupada.

যাইতে দেখিল পথে এক ন্যাসিবর ।
মহাভাগবত নাম পুরী যে ঈশ্বর ॥ ৫৮ ॥

yāite dekhila pathe eka nyāsibara |
mahābhāgabata nāma purī ye īśbara || 58 ||

yaite — going; dekhila pathe — saw on the road; eka nyasivara — the best of sannyasis; mahabhagavata — a maha-bhagavata; nama puri ye ishvara — named Ishvara Puri

58On the way He saw the best of sannyasis,
a maha-bhagavata named Ishvara Puri.

প্রণাম করিয়া তারে বৈল বিশ্বম্ভর ।
বড় ভাগ্যে দেখিল এ চরণযুগল ॥ ৫৯ ॥

praṇāma kariẏā tāre baila biśbambhara |
baṛa bhāgye dekhila e caraṇayugala || 59 ||

pranama kariya tare — bowing to him; baila vishvambhara — Vishvambhara said; bada bhagye — by great fortune; dekhila e charana-yugala — I have seen these two feet

59Bowing to him, Vishvambhara said:
"By great good fortune I have seen these two feet!"

চরণে পড়িয়া বোলে বচন কাতর ।
করুণ অরুণ আঁখি করে ছলছল ॥ ৬০ ॥

caraṇe paṛiẏā bole bacana kātara |
karuṇa aruṇa āṁkhi kare chalachala || 60 ||

charane padiya — falling at his feet; bole vachana katara — speaks plaintive words; karuna aruna ankhi — eyes full of entreaty and reddened; kare chhalachhala — brim with tears

60Falling at his feet, He speaks plaintive words;
His eyes, reddened and full of entreaty, fill with tears:

কেমনে তরিব এই সংসার-সাগরে ।
কৃষ্ণপাদাম্বুজ-ভক্তি দেহ ত আমারে ॥ ৬১ ॥

kemane tariba ei saṃsāra-sāgare |
kṛṣṇapādāmbuja-bhakti deha ta āmāre || 61 ||

kemane tariba — how shall I cross; ei samsara-sagare — this ocean of samsara; krishna-padambuja-bhakti — devotion to Krishna's lotus feet; deha ta amare — grant Me

61"How shall I cross this ocean of samsara?
Grant Me devotion to Krishna's lotus feet.

কৃষ্ণদীক্ষা বিনু দেহ অকারণ দেখি ।
পুরাণে এ সব বাক্য সাধুমুখে সাক্ষী ॥ ৬২ ॥

kṛṣṇadīkṣā binu deha akāraṇa dekhi |
purāṇe e saba bākya sādhumukhe sākṣī || 62 ||

krishna-diksha vinu — without Krishna initiation; deha akarana dekhi — the body, I see, is useless; purane e saba vakya — all these words in the Puranas; sadhu-mukhe sakshi — and the lips of saints bear witness

62Without initiation into the Krishna mantra the body, I see, is useless:
the words of the Puranas and the lips of the saints all bear witness to this"10.

এছন শুনিঞা বাণী পুরী যে ঈশ্বর ।
নিভৃতে কহিলা তারে মহামন্ত্রবর ॥ ৬৩ ॥

echana śuniñā bāṇī purī ye īśbara |
nibhṛte kahilā tāre mahāmantrabara || 63 ||

echhana shunina vani — hearing such words; puri ye ishvara — Ishvara Puri; nibhrite kahila tare — in private imparted to Him; mahamantra-vara — the great, best of mantras

63Hearing such words, Ishvara Puri
in private imparted to Him the great, the best of mantras.

গোপীনাথ-মহামন্ত্র পায় বিশ্বম্ভর ।
পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ হরিষ অন্তর ॥ ৬৪ ॥

gopīnātha-mahāmantra pāẏa biśbambhara |
pulakita saba aṅga hariṣa antara || 64 ||

gopinatha-mahamantra — the great mantra of Gopinatha; paya vishvambhara — Vishvambhara received; pulakita saba anga — His whole body thrilled; harisha antara — His heart rejoiced

64Vishvambhara received the great mantra of Gopinatha11,
His whole body thrilled, His heart rejoiced.

নয়নে গলয়ে নীর পুলকিত অঙ্গ ।
রাধা রাধা বলি সুখ বাড়িল তরঙ্গ ॥ ৬৫ ॥

naẏane galaẏe nīra pulakita aṅga |
rādhā rādhā bali sukha bāṛila taraṅga || 65 ||

nayane galaye nira — tears flow from the eyes; pulakita anga — the body thrills; radha radha bali — repeating "Radha, Radha"; sukha badila taranga — waves of happiness rose

65Tears flow from His eyes, His body trembles;
repeating "Radha, Radha!", He stirs up waves of happiness.

ব্রজের যতেক ভাব সব মনে হৈল ।
বিশেষে মাধুর্যরসে মন ডুবাইল ॥ ৬৬ ॥

brajera yateka bhāba saba mane haila |
biśeṣe mādhuryarase mana ḍubāila || 66 ||

vrajera yateka bhava — all the moods of Vraja; saba mane haila — arose in His mind; vishese — above all; madhurya-rase — in madhurya-rasa; mana dubaila — His mind plunged

66All the moods of Vraja awoke in His mind,
and above all His mind plunged into madhurya-rasa.

রাধাভাবে অবশ হইয়া কলেবর ।
কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ বলি ডাকে অতি উচ্চস্বর ॥ ৬৭ ॥

rādhābhābe abaśa haiẏā kalebara |
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa bali ḍāke ati uccasbara || 67 ||

radha-bhave — by the mood of Radha; avasha haiya kalevara — the body being overwhelmed; krishna krishna bali — "Krishna, Krishna!"; dake ati uchchasvara — calls very loudly

67His whole body overcome by the mood of Radha,
He calls in a loud voice: "Krishna, Krishna!"

বৃন্দাবন গোবর্ধন বলি ডাকে হাসে ।
কালিন্দী যমুনা বলি গর্জে উল্লাসে ॥ ৬৮ ॥

bṛndābana gobardhana bali ḍāke hāse |
kālindī yamunā bali garje ullāse || 68 ||

vrindavana govardhana bali — calling "Vrindavana, Govardhana!"; dake hase — calls and laughs; kalindi yamuna bali — crying "Kalindi, Yamuna!"; garje ullase — shouts in delight

68Calling "Vrindavana, Govardhana!", He laughs;
crying "Kalindi, Yamuna!", He shouts in delight.

ক্ষণে ডাকে বলরাম শ্রীদাম সুদাম ।
ক্ষণে নন্দ যশোদা বলিয়া করে নাম ॥ ৬৯ ॥

kṣaṇe ḍāke balarāma śrīdāma sudāma |
kṣaṇe nanda yaśodā baliẏā kare nāma || 69 ||

kshane dake — now calls; balarama shridama sudama — Balarama, Shridama, Sudama; kshane — now; nanda yashoda baliya kare nama — calls the names of Nanda and Yashoda

69Now He calls Balarama, Shridama, Sudama,
now He calls out the names of Nanda and Yashoda.

ধবলী সাঙলী বলি গরজে গম্ভীর ।
ক্ষণে সখী বলি প্রভু পড়য়ে অস্থির ॥ ৭০ ॥

dhabalī sāṅalī bali garaje gambhīra |
kṣaṇe sakhī bali prabhu paṛaẏe asthira || 70 ||

dhavali shangali bali — "Dhavali, Shangali!" (names of cows); garaje gambhira — He calls in a deep voice; kshane sakhi bali — now, crying "Friend!"; prabhu padaye asthira — the Lord falls down in agitation

70"Dhavali, Shangali!" — He calls in a deep voice;
now, crying "Friend!", the Lord falls down in agitation.

ক্ষণে দাস্যভাবে তৃণ দশনে ধরিয়া ।
ক্ষণে অহঙ্কার করে আমি সে বলিয়া ॥ ৭১ ॥

kṣaṇe dāsyabhābe tṛṇa daśane dhariẏā |
kṣaṇe ahaṅkāra kare āmi se baliẏā || 71 ||

kshane dasya-bhave — now in the mood of a servant; trina dashane dhariya — holding a straw between the teeth; kshane ahankara kare — now proudly; ami se bali — saying "It is I"

71Now in the mood of a servant He takes a straw between His teeth,
now proudly says: "It is I!

ধরিলুঁ পর্বত আমি মারিলুঁ অঘাসুর ।
মারিলুঁ পূতনা-আদি যতেক অসুর ॥ ৭২ ॥

dhariluṁ parbata āmi māriluṁ aghāsura |
māriluṁ pūtanā-ādi yateka asura || 72 ||

dharilun parvata ami — I held up the mountain; marilun aghasura — I killed Aghasura; marilun putana-adi — I killed Putana and the others; yateka asura — all the asuras

72I held up the mountain, I killed Aghasura,
I killed Putana and all the other asuras!"

ক্ষণে যে ত্রিভঙ্গ হঞা বংশীমুখে রহে ।
ক্ষণে চমকিত হঞা চৌদিগে ত চাহে ॥ ৭৩ ॥

kṣaṇe ye tribhaṅga hañā baṃśīmukhe rahe |
kṣaṇe camakita hañā caudige ta cāhe || 73 ||

kshane ye tribhanga hana — now, standing in the threefold-bending pose; vamshi-mukhe rahe — stays with the flute at His lips; kshane chamakita hana — now, startled; chaudige ta chahe — looks around in all directions

73Now, standing in the threefold-bending pose, He holds a flute to His lips,
now, startled, He looks around in all directions12.

নয়নে গলয়ে নীর গদগদ ভাষ ।
মধুর বচনে করে গুরুর সম্ভাষ ॥ ৭৪ ॥

naẏane galaẏe nīra gadagada bhāṣa |
madhura bacane kare gurura sambhāṣa || 74 ||

nayane galaye nira — tears flow from the eyes; gadagada bhasha — the voice falters; madhura vachane — with sweet words; kare gurura sambhasha — He addresses the guru

74Tears flow from His eyes, His voice falters;
with sweet words He addresses the guru:

তোমার প্রসাদে মুঞি হইনু কৃতার্থ ।
আজি হৈতে দেহ ধরা ভৈ গেল যথার্থ ॥ ৭৫ ॥

tomāra prasāde muñi hainu kṛtārtha |
āji haite deha dharā bhai gela yathārtha || 75 ||

tomara prasade — by your mercy; muni hainu kritartha — I have attained the goal; aji haite — from this day; deha dhara — embodiment; bhai gela yathartha — has become meaningful

75"By your mercy I have attained the goal:
from this day My embodiment has become meaningful."

ইহা শুনি ঈশ্বরপুরী নিজ-সুখে ।
ত্রিভঙ্গ মুরলী-মুখ দেখয়ে প্রভুকে ॥ ৭৫+১ ॥

ihā śuni īśbarapurī nija-sukhe |
tribhaṅga muralī-mukha dekhaẏe prabhuke || 75+1 ||

iha shuni — hearing this; ishvarapuri — Ishvara Puri; nija-sukhe — in his own bliss; tribhanga — in the threefold-bent pose; murali-mukha — with the flute at the lips; dekhaye prabhuke — sees the Lord

75+1Hearing this, Ishvara Puri, in his own bliss,
sees the Lord standing in the threefold-bent pose, with the flute at His lips13.

মাধবেন্দ্রপুরীর কথা হৈল স্মরণ ।
জানিলা সে কৃষ্ণচন্দ্র প্রকট এখন ॥ ৭৫+২ ॥

mādhabendrapurīra kathā haila smaraṇa |
jānilā se kṛṣṇacandra prakaṭa ekhana || 75+2 ||

madhavendrapurira katha — the words of Madhavendra Puri; haila smarana — came to mind; janila se — he understood; krishnachandra — Krishnachandra; prakata ekhana — has now appeared

75+2He remembered the words of Madhavendra Puri
and understood: Krishnachandra has now appeared.

গুরুভক্তি প্রকাশিয়া চলিলা ত প্রভু ।
ফল্গুনামা নদী দেখি হাসে লহু লহু ॥ ৭৬ ॥

gurubhakti prakāśiẏā calilā ta prabhu |
phalgunāmā nadī dekhi hāse lahu lahu || 76 ||

guru-bhakti prakashiya — having shown devotion to the guru; chalila ta prabhu — the Lord went on; phalgu-nama nadi dekhi — seeing the river named Phalgu; hase lahu lahu — gently smiled

76Having [thus] shown devotion to the guru, the Lord went on;
seeing the river named Phalgu, He gently smiled.

পূর্বস্মরণ হইল হরিষ-বিষাদে ।
সীতা সঙরিয়া হইল পরম প্রমাদে ॥ ৭৭ ॥

pūrbasmaraṇa haila hariṣa-biṣāde |
sītā saṅariẏā haila parama pramāde || 77 ||

purva-smarana haila — He remembered the past; harisha-vishade — in joy and sorrow; sita sanariya — remembering Sita; haila parama pramade — fell into great agitation

77He remembered the past — in joy and sorrow;
remembering Sita, He fell into great agitation14.

দেবপূজা পিতৃপূজা কৈল স্নানদান ।
প্রেতশিলায় পিণ্ডদান করিল বিধান ॥ ৭৮ ॥

debapūjā pitṛpūjā kaila snānadāna |
pretaśilāẏa piṇḍadāna karila bidhāna || 78 ||

deva-puja pitri-puja — worship of gods and ancestors; kaila snana-dana — He bathed and gave gifts; pretashilaya pinda-dana — the offering of pinda on the Pretashila; karila vidhana — He duly performed

78He worshipped the gods and the ancestors, bathed and gave gifts,
and duly offered pinda on the Pretashila.

ব্রাহ্মণেরে দিল ধন পিতার উদ্দেশে ।
উদীচী করিয়া কৈল দক্ষিণ-মানসে ॥ ৭৯ ॥

brāhmaṇere dila dhana pitāra uddeśe |
udīcī kariẏā kaila dakṣiṇa-mānase || 79 ||

brahmanere dila dhana — gave wealth to the brahmanas; pitara uddeshe — for His father; udichi kariya — performing [the rite at] Udichi; kaila dakshina-manase — performed it at Dakshina-manasa

79For His father He gave wealth to the brahmanas;
having performed [the rite at] Udichi, He performed it at Dakshina-manasa.

উত্তর-মানস করি জিহ্বালোল তীর্থ ।
দেব পিতৃ-পূজা করি বিলাইল অর্থ ॥ ৮০ ॥

uttara-mānasa kari jihbālola tīrtha |
deba pitṛ-pūjā kari bilāila artha || 80 ||

uttara-manasa kari — performing at Uttara-manasa; jihvalola tirtha — [and at] the holy place Jihvalola; deva pitri-puja kari — worshipping gods and ancestors; bilaila artha — He distributed wealth

80Performing [the rite] at Uttara-manasa and at the holy place Jihvalola,
worshipping the gods and the ancestors, He distributed wealth15.

তবে গয়া উত্তরিলা অতি হৃষ্টমনে ।
দেখিতে বাড়িল আর্তি বিষ্ণুর চরণে ॥ ৮১ ॥

tabe gaẏā uttarilā ati hṛṣṭamane |
dekhite bāṛila ārti biṣṇura caraṇe || 81 ||

tabe — then; gaya uttarila — He arrived in Gaya; ati hrishta-mane — with great joy in His heart; dekhite badila arti — the longing to see grew; vishnura charane — the foot of Vishnu

81Then with great joy in His heart He arrived in Gaya;
His longing to see the foot of Vishnu grew.

ষোড়শ বেদিকায় প্রভু পিণ্ডদান করে ।
উৎকণ্ঠা বাড়িল বিষ্ণুপদ দেখিবারে ॥ ৮২ ॥

ṣoṛaśa bedikāẏa prabhu piṇḍadāna kare |
utkaṇṭhā bāṛila biṣṇupada dekhibāre || 82 ||

shodasha vedikaya — at the Sixteen Altars; prabhu pinda-dana kare — the Lord offers pindas; utkantha badila — eagerness grew; vishnupada dekhibare — to see the Vishnupada

82The Lord offers pindas at the Sixteen Altars;
His eagerness to see the Vishnupada grew.

সর্বকার্য সমাপিয়া চলিলা ত্বরিতে ।
বিষ্ণুপদ দেখিবারে হরষিত চিতে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

sarbakārya samāpiẏā calilā tbarite |
biṣṇupada dekhibāre haraṣita cite || 83 ||

sarva-karya samapiya — having finished all the rites; chalila tvarite — He went quickly; vishnupada dekhibare — to see the Vishnupada; harashita chite — with a joyful heart

83Having finished all the rites, He went quickly,
with a joyful heart, to see the Vishnupada.

বিষ্ণুপদ-চিহ্ন আমি দেখিব নয়নে ।
হরিষে অন্তর-কথা কহে মনে মনে ॥ ৮৪ ॥

biṣṇupada-cihna āmi dekhiba naẏane |
hariṣe antara-kathā kahe mane mane || 84 ||

vishnupada-chihna — the marks of Vishnu's foot; ami dekhiba nayane — I shall see with My eyes; harishe — joyfully; antara-katha — what is in His heart; kahe mane mane — He says to Himself

84"With My own eyes I shall see the marks of Vishnu's foot!" —
joyfully He says to Himself what is in His heart.

এত ভাবি উত্তরিলা বিষ্ণুপদে আসি ।
পরম-আনন্দে দণ্ডবত করি বসি ॥ ৮৫ ॥

eta bhābi uttarilā biṣṇupade āsi |
parama-ānande daṇḍabata kari basi || 85 ||

eta bhavi — thinking so; uttarila vishnupade asi — He came to the Vishnupada; parama-anande — in supreme bliss; dandavata kari — bowing down; basi — He sat

85Thinking so, He came to the Vishnupada
and in supreme bliss, having bowed down, sat.

বোলয়ে গৌরাঙ্গ শুন শুন সর্বজন ।
কেমন করয়ে বিষ্ণুপদ দেখি মন ॥ ৮৬ ॥

bolaẏe gaurāṅga śuna śuna sarbajana |
kemana karaẏe biṣṇupada dekhi mana || 86 ||

bolaye gauranga — Gauranga says; shuna shuna sarvajana — listen, listen, all of you; kemana karaye — how does it become; vishnupada dekhi — on seeing the Vishnupada; mana — the heart

86Gauranga says: "Listen, listen, all of you:
what happens in the heart when one sees the Vishnupada?

বিষ্ণুপদ-চিহ্ন আমি দেখিলুঁ নয়নে ।
দেখিয়া ত প্রেমোদয় না হইল কেনে ॥ ৮৭ ॥

biṣṇupada-cihna āmi dekhiluṁ naẏane |
dekhiẏā ta premodaẏa nā haila kene || 87 ||

vishnupada-chihna — the marks of Vishnu's foot; ami dekhilun nayane — I have seen with My eyes; dekhiya ta — having seen them; premodaya na haila kene — why has prema not arisen

87I have seen with My own eyes the marks of Vishnu's foot —
why then, having seen them, has prema not arisen?"16

ইহা বলি মহাপ্রভু পাখালে বিষ্ণুপদ ।
অভিষেক করি কৈল হিয়ার প্রসাদ ॥ ৮৮ ॥

ihā bali mahāprabhu pākhāle biṣṇupada |
abhiṣeka kari kaila hiẏāra prasāda || 88 ||

iha bali — saying this; mahaprabhu pakhale vishnupada — Mahaprabhu washed the Vishnupada; abhisheka kari — performing abhisheka; kaila hiyara prasada — His heart was gladdened

88Saying this, Mahaprabhu washed the Vishnupada,
performed abhisheka — and His heart was filled with joy.

ভক্তি প্রকাশিয়া প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর হরি ।
প্রকাশ করয়ে গোরা প্রেম-অধিকারী ॥ ৮৯ ॥

bhakti prakāśiẏā prabhu biśbambhara hari |
prakāśa karaẏe gorā prema-adhikārī || 89 ||

bhakti prakashiya — showing bhakti; prabhu vishvambhara hari — the Lord Vishvambhara Hari; prakasha karaye — manifests; gora — Gora; prema-adhikari — the possessor of prema

89Showing bhakti, the Lord Vishvambhara Hari —
Gora, the possessor of prema — manifests [it]:

কম্প পুলক ভেল প্রেমার আরম্ভ ।
নয়নে গলয়ে ধারা ক্ষণে হয় স্তম্ভ ॥ ৯০ ॥

kampa pulaka bhela premāra ārambha |
naẏane galaẏe dhārā kṣaṇe haẏa stambha || 90 ||

kampa pulaka — trembling, hair on end; bhela premara arambha — prema began; nayane galaye dhara — streams flow from the eyes; kshane haya stambha — at times He is stunned

90prema began — trembling, hair standing on end,
streams flow from His eyes, at times He becomes stunned.

বিভোল হইলা প্রভু পাদাব্জ দেখিয়া ।
প্রেম-মহামহোৎসবে বুলয়ে নাচিয়া ॥ ৯১ ॥

bibhola hailā prabhu pādābja dekhiẏā |
prema-mahāmahotsabe bulaẏe nāciẏā || 91 ||

bibhola haila prabhu — the Lord lost Himself; padabja dekhiya — seeing the lotus foot; prema-maha-mahotsave — in a great festival of prema; bulaye nachiya — moves about dancing

91Seeing the lotus foot, the Lord lost Himself
and in a great festival of prema moves about, dancing.

গয়াশিরে পিণ্ডদান পাদাব্জ-উপর ।
আনন্দে নাচয়ে সঙ্গে ব্রাহ্মণ সকল ॥ ৯২ ॥

gaẏāśire piṇḍadāna pādābja-upara |
ānande nācaẏe saṅge brāhmaṇa sakala || 92 ||

gaya-shire — on the head of Gaya; pinda-dana — the offering of pinda; padabja-upara — on the lotus foot; anande nachaye sange — in joy dance together [with Him]; brahmana sakala — all the brahmanas

92He offered pinda on the head of Gaya, on the lotus foot;
in joy all the brahmanas dance together [with Him].

আর দিনে মনঃকথা দঢ়াইল চিতে ।
মধুপুরী-যাত্রা প্রভু কৈল আচম্বিতে ॥ ৯৩ ॥

āra dine manaḥkathā daṛhāila cite |
madhupurī-yātrā prabhu kaila ācambite || 93 ||

ara dine — on the next day; manah-katha — the secret desire; dadhaila chite — took firm hold in His heart; madhupuri-yatra — the journey to Madhupuri; prabhu kaila achambite — the Lord suddenly undertook

93On the next day the secret desire took firm hold in His heart:
the Lord suddenly set out for Madhupuri.

সঙ্গের ব্রাহ্মণগণে কহিল বচন ।
বৃন্দাবন-দরশনে করহ গমন ॥ ৯৪ ॥

saṅgera brāhmaṇagaṇe kahila bacana |
bṛndābana-daraśane karaha gamana || 94 ||

sangera brahmana-gane — to the brahmana companions; kahila vachana — He said; vrindavana-darashane — to see Vrindavana; karaha gamana — let us go

94He said to His brahmana companions:
"Let us go to see Vrindavana."

শুনিয়া সঙ্গতিগণ কুণ্ঠিত হইলা ।
যাইতে নারিব ব্যয় অল্প হইলা ॥ ৯৫ ॥

śuniẏā saṅgatigaṇa kuṇṭhita hailā |
yāite nāriba byaẏa alpa hailā || 95 ||

shuniya — hearing; sangati-gana — the companions; kunthita haila — were dismayed; yaite nariba — we cannot go; vyaya alpa haila — our means are small

95Hearing this, the companions were dismayed:
"We cannot go — our means are small."

প্রভু কহে ভক্ষ্য-সঙ্গে মনুষ্যের জন্ম ।
না বুঝি বিকল হঞা করে কত কর্ম ॥ ৯৬ ॥

prabhu kahe bhakṣya-saṅge manuṣyera janma |
nā bujhi bikala hañā kare kata karma || 96 ||

prabhu kahe — the Lord says; bhakshya-sange — together with the care for food; manushyera janma — the birth of man; na bujhi — not understanding; vikala hana — anxiously; kare kata karma — performs so many works

96The Lord says: "From birth man is bound by the care for food;
not understanding [life's goal], he anxiously performs many works.

সার্থক মনুষ্য-জন্ম কৃষ্ণ যদি ভজে ।
না ভজিলে কৃষ্ণ দুঃখ-সাগরেতে মজে ॥ ৯৭ ॥

sārthaka manuṣya-janma kṛṣṇa yadi bhaje |
nā bhajile kṛṣṇa duḥkha-sāgarete maje || 97 ||

sarthaka manushya-janma — human birth is meaningful; krishna yadi bhaje — if one worships Krishna; na bhajile krishna — not worshipping Krishna; duhkha-sagarete maje — one sinks in an ocean of suffering

97Human birth becomes meaningful if one worships Krishna;
but not worshipping Krishna, one sinks in an ocean of suffering."

এইমত বুঝাইয়া প্রভু গৌরহরি ।
গয়া হৈতে বৃন্দাবন প্রভু যাত্রা করি ॥ ৯৮ ॥

eimata bujhāiẏā prabhu gaurahari |
gaẏā haite bṛndābana prabhu yātrā kari || 98 ||

eimata bujhaiya — having explained thus; prabhu gaurahari — the Lord Gaurahari; gaya haite vrindavana — from Gaya to Vrindavana; prabhu yatra kari — the Lord set out

98Having explained all this, the Lord Gaurahari
set out from Gaya for Vrindavana.

সঙ্গিগণ সঙ্গে করি চলিলা আপনি ।
হেনকালে উঠি গেল আকাশেতে বাণী ॥ ৯৯ ॥

saṅgigaṇa saṅge kari calilā āpani |
henakāle uṭhi gela ākāśete bāṇī || 99 ||

sangi-gana sange kari — together with the companions; chalila apani — He Himself set out; henakale — then; uthi gela akashete vani — a voice rose in the sky

99He Himself set out together with His companions;
and then a voice rang out from the sky,

নূতন মেঘের যেন গভীর গর্জন ।
বিশ্বম্ভর সম্বোধিয়া কহিল বচন ॥ ১০০ ॥

nūtana meghera yena gabhīra garjana |
biśbambhara sambodhiẏā kahila bacana || 100 ||

nutana meghera — of a fresh cloud; yena gabhira garjana — like the deep thunder; vishvambhara sambodhiya — addressing Vishvambhara; kahila vachana — it said

100like the deep thunder of a fresh cloud;
addressing Vishvambhara, it said:

শুন শুন মহাপ্রভু অহে বিশ্বম্ভর ।
না যাইবে বৃন্দাবন যাহ নিজ ঘর ॥ ১০১ ॥

śuna śuna mahāprabhu ahe biśbambhara |
nā yāibe bṛndābana yāha nija ghara || 101 ||

shuna shuna mahaprabhu — listen, listen, Mahaprabhu; ahe vishvambhara — O Vishvambhara; na yaibe vrindavana — do not go to Vrindavana; yaha nija ghara — go to Your home

101"Listen, listen, Mahaprabhu, O Vishvambhara:
do not go to Vrindavana — go home.

সন্ন্যাস করিয়া তীর্থ করিবে পর্যটন ।
সময়ের বশ হঞা যাবে বৃন্দাবন ॥ ১০২ ॥

sannyāsa kariẏā tīrtha karibe paryaṭana |
samaẏera baśa hañā yābe bṛndābana || 102 ||

sannyasa kariya — having taken sannyasa; tirtha karibe paryatana — You will travel to the holy places; samayera vasha hana — in due time; yabe vrindavana — You will go to Vrindavana

102Having taken sannyasa, You will travel to the holy places
and in due time You will go to Vrindavana"17.

এইমত দৈববাণী শুনি নিজ কর্ণে ।
গমন-নিরোধ কৈল সঙ্গের ব্রাহ্মণে ॥ ১০৩ ॥

eimata daibabāṇī śuni nija karṇe |
gamana-nirodha kaila saṅgera brāhmaṇe || 103 ||

eimata daiva-vani — such a heavenly voice; shuni nija karne — hearing with their own ears; gamana-nirodha kaila — held [Him] back from going; sangera brahmane — the brahmana companions

103Hearing such a heavenly voice with their own ears,
the brahmana companions held Him back from going.

লেউটিয়া মহাপ্রভু ঘরেতে চলিলা ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে পদব্রজে নদীয়া আইলা ॥ ১০৪ ॥

leuṭiẏā mahāprabhu gharete calilā |
krame krame padabraje nadīẏā āilā || 104 ||

leutiya — turning back; mahaprabhu gharete chalila — Mahaprabhu went home; krame krame — little by little; padavraje — on foot; nadiya aila — came to Nadia

104Turning back, Mahaprabhu went home
and little by little, on foot, came to Nadia.

নমস্কার করি শচী-মায়ের চরণে ।
ঘরেরে বিদায় দিলা যত সঙ্গিগণে ॥ ১০৫ ॥

namaskāra kari śacī-māẏera caraṇe |
gharere bidāẏa dilā yata saṅgigaṇe || 105 ||

namaskara kari — bowing; shachi-mayera charane — at the feet of mother Shachi; gharere bidaya dila — sent home; yata sangi-gane — all the companions

105Bowing at the feet of His mother Shachi,
He sent all His companions to their homes.

পুত্র কোলে করি শচী আনন্দিত মনে ।
হরিষে প্রেমার নীর ঝরে দুনয়নে ॥ ১০৬ ॥

putra kole kari śacī ānandita mane |
hariṣe premāra nīra jhare dunaẏane || 106 ||

putra kole kari — embracing her son; shachi anandita mane — Shachi with joy in her heart; harishe — for joy; premara nira — tears of love; jhare dunayane — stream from both eyes

106Shachi, with joy in her heart, embraced her son;
tears of love and joy stream from both her eyes.

পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ কম্প কলেবর ।
আনন্দে পাইল সব নদীয়া নগর ॥ ১০৭ ॥

pulakita saba aṅga kampa kalebara |
ānande pāila saba nadīẏā nagara || 107 ||

pulakita saba anga — the whole body thrills; kampa kalevara — the body trembles; anande paila — received joy; saba nadiya nagara — the whole town of Nadia

107Her whole body thrills, her body trembles;
the whole town of Nadia received joy.

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া-হিয়া মাঝে আনন্দ-হিল্লোল ।
ধরিতে না পারে অঙ্গ সুখের নাহি ওর ॥ ১০৮ ॥

biṣṇupriẏā-hiẏā mājhe ānanda-hillola |
dharite nā pāre aṅga sukhera nāhi ora || 108 ||

vishnupriya-hiya majhe — in Vishnupriya's heart; ananda-hillola — waves of joy; dharite na pare anga — she cannot contain herself; sukhera nahi ora — her happiness has no limit

108In Vishnupriya's heart there are waves of joy:
she cannot contain herself, her happiness has no limit.

আনন্দে আইলা প্রভু আপন আবাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১০৯ ॥

ānande āilā prabhu āpana ābāsa |
gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 109 ||

anande aila prabhu — joyfully the Lord came; apana avasa — to His own abode; gora-guna gaya — sings Gora's glories; sukhe — happily; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

109With joy the Lord came to His own abode —
happily this Lochana Dasa sings the glories of Gora.

Raga varadi; disha: "Dvijachand!..." (murchha)

নবদ্বীপ-চরিত্র সে অপরূপ কথা ।
অমিয় মাখিল গোরাচাঁদ-গুণগাথা ॥ ১১০ ॥

nabadbīpa-caritra se aparūpa kathā |
amiẏa mākhila gorācāṁda-guṇagāthā || 110 ||

navadvipa-charitra — the deeds in Navadvipa; se aparupa katha — are a wondrous tale; amiya makhila — steeped in nectar; gorachanda-guna-gatha — the song of Gorachand's glories

110The deeds [of the Lord] in Navadvipa are a wondrous tale:
the account of Gorachand's glories is steeped in nectar.

লোকবেদ-অগোচর নদীয়া-চরিত ।
শ্রবণ-মঙ্গল হয় সভার পিরীত ॥ ১১১ ॥

lokabeda-agocara nadīẏā-carita |
śrabaṇa-maṅgala haẏa sabhāra pirīta || 111 ||

loka-veda-agochara — beyond the reach of the world and the Vedas; nadiya-charita — the deeds in Nadia; shravana-mangala haya — hearing them is auspicious; sabhara pirita — beloved of all

111The deeds in Nadia are beyond the reach of the world and of the Vedas;
hearing them is auspicious — all love them.

শিব শুক নারদ এ লখিমী অনন্ত ।
যেই সুখে আপনাকে মানে ভাগ্যবন্ত ॥ ১১২ ॥

śiba śuka nārada e lakhimī ananta |
yei sukhe āpanāke māne bhāgyabanta || 112 ||

shiva shuka narada — Shiva, Shuka, Narada; e lakhimi ananta — and Lakshmi, Ananta; yei sukhe — in this joy; apanake mane bhagyavanta — consider themselves fortunate

112Shiva, Shuka, Narada, Lakshmi, Ananta,
tasting this joy, consider themselves fortunate.

আমি ছার কি বলিব অতি বুদ্ধিহীন ।
ভালমন্দ নাহি জ্ঞান নাহি নিশা দিন ॥ ১১৩ ॥

āmi chāra ki baliba ati buddhihīna |
bhālamanda nāhi jñāna nāhi niśā dina || 113 ||

ami chhara — I, wretched; ki baliba — what shall I say; ati buddhi-hina — utterly without understanding; bhala-manda nahi jnana — no knowledge of good or bad; nahi nisha dina — nor of night and day

113What can I say, wretched and utterly without understanding?
I know neither good nor bad, neither day nor night.

পশুর চরিতে মোর আচরণ একে ।
তাহাতে অধম বলি লিখিয়ে আমাকে ॥ ১১৪ ॥

paśura carite mora ācaraṇa eke |
tāhāte adhama bali likhiẏe āmāke || 114 ||

pashura charite — like the conduct of a beast; mora acharana eke — my conduct is the same; tahate — therefore; adhama bali — as the lowest; likhiye amake — I write of myself

114My conduct is like that of a beast,
therefore I write of myself that I am the lowest.

সব অবতার-সার গোরা-অবতার ।
তাহাতে নদীয়াপুরে প্রেমার প্রচার ॥ ১১৫ ॥

saba abatāra-sāra gorā-abatāra |
tāhāte nadīẏāpure premāra pracāra || 115 ||

saba avatara-sara — the essence of all avataras; gora-avatara — the avatara of Gora; tahate — in it; nadiya-pure — in Nadia; premara prachara — the preaching of prema

115The essence of all avataras is the avatara of Gora,
and in it — the preaching of prema in Nadia.

প্রণতি করিয়া বোলোঁ বৈষ্ণব-চরণে ।
কৃপা কর গোরাগুণ গাঙ মো-বদনে ॥ ১১৬ ॥

praṇati kariẏā boloṁ baiṣṇaba-caraṇe |
kṛpā kara gorāguṇa gāṅa mo-badane || 116 ||

pranati kariya — bowing down; bolon vaishnava-charane — I beseech the feet of the Vaishnavas; kripa kara — be merciful; gora-guna — Gora's glories; gaun mo-vadane — may my lips sing

116Bowing down, I beseech the feet of the Vaishnavas:
be merciful — let my lips sing the glories of Gora.

অধম বলিয়া ঘৃণা না করিহ মোরে ।
পতিতের ত্রাণ লোকে বোলে তো সভারে ॥ ১১৭ ॥

adhama baliẏā ghṛṇā nā kariha more |
patitera trāṇa loke bole to sabhāre || 117 ||

adhama baliya — because I am low; ghrina na kariha more — do not despise me; patitera trana — the deliverance of the fallen; loke bole to sabhare — people call all of you

117Do not despise me because I am low:
people say that you are the deliverance of the fallen.

নিজগুণে দয়া করি কর পরসাদ ।
গোরাগুণ গাঙ মুখে বড় লাগে সাধ ॥ ১১৮ ॥

nijaguṇe daẏā kari kara parasāda |
gorāguṇa gāṅa mukhe baṛa lāge sādha || 118 ||

nijagune — out of your own goodness; daya kari — taking pity; kara parasada — show me mercy; gora-guna gaun mukhe — to sing Gora's glories with my lips; bada lage sadha — I long so much

118Out of your own goodness show me mercy:
I long so much to sing with my lips the glories of Gora.

গোরাপদ-কমলে মো করি পরণতি ।
তিলেক করুণা-দিঠে কর অবগতি ॥ ১১৯ ॥

gorāpada-kamale mo kari paraṇati |
tileka karuṇā-diṭhe kara abagati || 119 ||

gora-pada-kamale — to the lotus feet of Gora; mo kari paranati — I bow down; tileka — even for a moment; karuna-dithe — with a merciful glance; kara avagati — look upon me

119I bow down to the lotus feet of Gora:
cast on me, even for a moment, a merciful glance.

শ্রীনরহরিদাস ঠাকুর আমার ।
এই তো ভরসা গুণ বলি যে তোমার ॥ ১২০ ॥

śrīnaraharidāsa ṭhākura āmāra |
ei to bharasā guṇa bali ye tomāra || 120 ||

shri-narahari-dasa thakura — Sri Narahari Dasa Thakura; amara — is mine; ei to bharasa — this is my reliance; guna bali ye tomara — in speaking of Your glories

120Sri Narahari Dasa Thakura is my [master]:
on this alone I rely in speaking of Your glories18.

নহে বা অধমাধম মুঞি পাপী ছার ।
তোর গুণ কহিবারে কিবা অধিকার ॥ ১২১ ॥

nahe bā adhamādhama muñi pāpī chāra |
tora guṇa kahibāre kibā adhikāra || 121 ||

nahe va — otherwise; adhamadhama muni — I, lowest of the low; papi chhara — sinful, wretched; tora guna kahibare — to tell Your glories; kiba adhikara — what right

121Otherwise — I, lowest of the low, sinful, wretched —
what right have I to speak of Your glories?

অধিকারী নহোঁ মুঞি কর পরসাদ ।
তোর গুণ কহিবারে বড় লাগে সাধ ॥ ১২২ ॥

adhikārī nahoṁ muñi kara parasāda |
tora guṇa kahibāre baṛa lāge sādha || 122 ||

adhikari nahon muni — I am not worthy; kara parasada — show mercy; tora guna kahibare — to tell Your glories; bada lage sadha — I long so much

122I am not worthy — show me mercy:
I long so much to speak of Your glories.

যে হউ সে হউ কথা কহিব অবশ্য ।
সাবধানে শুন কথা নদীয়া-রহস্য ॥ ১২৩ ॥

ye hau se hau kathā kahiba abaśya |
sābadhāne śuna kathā nadīẏā-rahasya || 123 ||

ye hau se hau — come what may; katha kahiba avashya — I shall certainly tell; savadhane shuna — listen attentively; katha nadiya-rahasya — the tale, the secret of Nadia

123Come what may, I shall certainly tell it:
listen attentively to the secret of Nadia.

জানি বা না জানি কহি বড় প্রতি-আশে ।
আদিখণ্ড সায় কহে এ লোচনদাসে ॥ ১২৪ ॥

jāni bā nā jāni kahi baṛa prati-āśe |
ādikhaṇḍa sāẏa kahe e locanadāse || 124 ||

jani va na jani — knowing or not knowing; kahi bada prati-ashe — I speak with great hope; adikhanda saya — the Adi-khanda is ended; kahe e lochanadase — says this Lochana Dasa

124Knowing or not knowing, I speak with great hope:
"The Adi-khanda is ended," says this Lochana Dasa.

Thus ends the Adi-khanda of the Sri Chaitanya-mangala, composed by Sri Lochana Dasa Thakura.

✦

Notes

  1. Cf. Murari 1.15–1.16. In Lochana Dasa's text the Lord meets Ishvara Puri already on the way to the Vishnupada (vv. 57–58), before the rites at the Phalgu and in Gaya itself.
  2. Gaya — a holy city in Bihar where pindas are offered to the ancestors. In performing the shraddha the Lord, as on other occasions, "instructs the people" by His own example (cf. Murari 1.15.6).
  3. V. 13+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition does not have it. Shachi asks to share in the blessing of the Gaya-shraddha performed by her son.
  4. In Murari (1.15.8) the river is called Chorandhayaka. Mandara — a holy mountain in Bihar where Madhusudana is worshipped (cf. v. 50).
  5. The Lord's companions from Bengal found fault with the local brahmanas, whose customs differed from those of Bengal; cf. Murari 1.15.12: these brahmanas had taken refuge in Madhusudana.
  6. The Lord is not subject to illness: Bhaktisiddhanta in his summary says that He "enacted the lila of being cured" in order to teach reverence for brahmanas; cf. Murari 1.15.9–13. The 1903 edition gives in its notes several more couplets from individual manuscripts (among them the Lord recalls how once in His childhood His mother gave Him the water of a brahmana's feet); A and B do not have them.
  7. Brahmanya — "kind to brahmanas", a name of the Lord. The sage Bhrigu, testing the gods, struck Vishnu on the chest with his foot, and the Lord bears the mark of his foot as a sign of respect for brahmanas (cf. Bhagavata 10.89). The 1903 edition gives vv. 45–47 only in a note as an additional reading of the printed edition.
  8. The 1983 edition: "Thus in the Padma Purana". Bhaktisiddhanta's prose rendering of the shloka (anvaya and translation) is not translated.
  9. Punahpuna (modern Punpun) — a holy river on the way to Gaya; Rajagiri (Rajagriha, modern Rajgir) with the pond Brahma-kunda — an ancient holy place in Bihar. Cf. Murari 1.15.13–14.
  10. The Lord, Himself the Teacher of the world, speaks as a seeking disciple, teaching people that everyone needs initiation from a genuine guru; according to Bhaktisiddhanta's summary He asked for the mantra in order to show mercy to Ishvara Puri. Cf. Murari 1.15.16–19.
  11. That is, the mantra of Krishna, the Lord of the gopis. In Murari (1.15.18) and in Vrindavana Dasa (Chaitanya-bhagavata, Adi 17) it is the ten-syllable mantra.
  12. After the initiation the moods of Vraja manifest in the Lord: the mood of Radha (vv. 65–67, 70), His own mood as Krishna (vv. 71–73), the mood of a servant (v. 71). Gaudiya Vaishnavas see in Gaura Krishna Himself, who has taken the mood and the radiance of Radha.
  13. Vv. 75+1 – 75+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition gives them in a note as the additional reading of another printed edition. Madhavendra Puri is Ishvara Puri's guru, the root of the tree of prema (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 9.10–11); apparently his words about Krishna's imminent appearance are meant.
  14. The Lord remembered His lila as Rama. According to the tradition of Gaya, Sita, having offered pinda to Dasharatha in Rama's absence, called the Phalgu to witness, but the river lied, and Sita cursed it to flow beneath the sand.
  15. The Pretashila, Udichi, Dakshina-manasa, Uttara-manasa, Jihvalola and the Sixteen Altars (v. 82) are holy places of Gaya where the shraddha is performed; cf. Murari 1.16.1–4.
  16. Cf. Murari 1.16.6–7. The Lord, as a devotee, laments a seeming lack of love — thus He teaches humility; at once prema awakens in Him (vv. 88–91).
  17. Cf. Murari 1.16.8–10. The heavenly voice foretells the Lord's sannyasa and His journey to Vrindavana.
